blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Reversing Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis “Chiz Escudero’s previous ruling that required 16 votes to convict Vice President Sara Duterte will not violate her right to due process. This view was expressed by three retired Supreme Court (SC) justices on Wednesday at the impeachment trial. As the impeachment court considers whether or not Escudero’s prior ruling on the voting base, Senator-judge Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan asked the invited amici curiae (friends of the court) whether changing the voting threshold would constitute as a violation of Duterte’s due process.
